**Credit Analysis:**

The issuer exhibits an exceptionally strong balance sheet with high liquidity (current ratio of 3.83x) and a very low leverage profile (total liabilities representing only 21.5% of total assets). The business model is highly profitable with an outstanding 94% gross margin and positive operating and net income, though the significantly negative retained earnings (-$1,564M) indicate substantial historical losses or aggressive recapitalizations that constrain the rating from the highest investment-grade categories. Balancing the robust current financial health and profitability against the accumulated deficit and moderate absolute operating income scale ($90M), the issuer warrants a solid investment-grade rating.

DECISION: BBB+
